title: Robot with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='26' x2='50' y2='14' stroke='#7ee8ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='4' fill='#ffde59'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='2' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='24' y='26' width='52' height='40' rx='10' fill='#5ec8e6'/>
  <rect x='24' y='26' width='52' height='40' rx='10' fill='none' stroke='#a8ecff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='30' y='32' width='40' height='28' rx='6' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <polygon points='40,38 42,43 47,43 43,46 45,51 40,48 35,51 37,46 33,43 38,43'/>
    <polygon points='60,38 62,43 67,43 63,46 65,51 60,48 55,51 57,46 53,43 58,43'/>
  </g>
  <!-- eye sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 54 Q50 60 60 54' fill='none' stroke='#8fe0f5' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <rect x='20' y='40' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ff9f6e'/>
  <rect x='74' y='40' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ff9f6e'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='32' y='68' width='36' height='24' rx='8' fill='#7ed6a8'/>
  <rect x='32' y='68' width='36' height='24' rx='8' fill='none' stroke='#b6f5d0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- chest light -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='5' fill='#ffde59'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <rect x='22' y='70' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#ff9f6e'/>
  <rect x='70' y='70' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#ff9f6e'/>
</svg>
